data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2020 was GBP 152.02m. The report discloses a small prior year development outcome: a net prior-year release of GBP 1.8m (net of reinsurance) is stated, however no explicit GROSS prior-year movement is provided. The gross claims development triangle shows effectively no aggregate movement on underwriting years prior to 2019 (computed gross PYD = 0.0). The syndicate reports higher current year loss activity including Covid-19 related event cancellation losses which are largely reinsured/intercompany limited.
raw_causal_phrases: Net claims incurred include prior year reserve releases totaling GBP 1.8m (2019: GBP 7.9m release) on an accident year basis.
The event cancellation (Contingency) business has substantial gross losses due to Covid-19 which are limited to GBP 2.0m by intercompany reinsurance.

The net loss ratio for 2020 of 57.9% was 4.4% higher than 2019 due to several large claims incurred during the year, in addition to 2.6% (2019: nil) large catastrophe experience, which includes Covid-19 loss provisions.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement figure was stated in the notes. The only explicit prior-year movement statement was a net release of GBP 1.8m (net of reinsurance). A gross prior-year movement was computed from the gross claims development triangle (gross triangle shows no aggregate movement for underwriting years <=2018) resulting in an aggregate gross PYD of 0.0. Therefore prior_year_development_gbp_m is reported as 0.0 (gross). If a gross movement note exists elsewhere in supporting schedules it was not located in the main notes; reported net PYD (GBP 1.8m) is available and has been quoted verbatim in exact_reserve_text.
